The scan covered every ref reachable through `git rev-list --all` at the
PB-016 checkpoint. Gitleaks 8.30.0 produced 83 redacted candidates. Every
candidate was a generated test-store `api_key` record: its key and value had
the same synthetic 64-lowercase-hex shape, explicit test metadata, a past
expiry, and a path deleted from the current tree. TruffleHog 3.95.9 produced
nine unverified candidates (the handoff's eight plus one later security-test
fixture): one dependency checksum and eight URI rejection/test-service
fixtures. It produced zero verified results.
No candidate maps to a production issuer, deployed account, or live rotation
target. Historical test-store records were removed before this checkpoint,
current ignores prevent recurrence, and no value is reproduced here.
